verdict.rationale: LangGraph is an orchestration framework that also has a hosted deployment platform (LangSmith Deployment), so a buyer could fairly ask about its data-training posture. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses whether customer data is used for model training, nor any opt-out or no-training commitment. Self-hosted persistence such as a PostgresSaver checkpointer is a storage choice, not a training-data control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
